input

Input box. It is a native component. Pay attention to related restrictions when using it.

Attribute Type Default Value Mandatory or Not Description
value String Yes Initial content in the input box.
type String text No Input type.
password Boolean false No Whether the input is the password type.
placeholder String Yes Placeholder when the text box is empty.
placeholder-style String Yes Placeholder style. The options are as follows: color, font-size, and font-weight.
placeholder-class String input-placeholder No Placeholder style class. The options are as follows: color, font-size, and font-weight.
disabled Boolean false No Disabled or not.
maxlength Number 140 No Maximum input length. The value -1 indicates that the maximum length is not limited.
focus Boolean false No Whether to obtain the focus.
confirm-type String done No Text of the button in the lower right corner of the keyboard. It is available only when type is set to 'text'.
confirm-hold Boolean false No Whether to keep the keyboard unstuck when you tap the button in the lower right corner of the keyboard.
cursor Number -1 Yes Pointer position when the focus is specified. The default value is the end of the line.
selection-start Number -1 No Start position of the cursor. It is valid for automatic aggregation and needs to be used with selection-end.
selection-end Number -1 No End position of the cursor. It is valid for automatic aggregation and needs to be used with selection-start.
adjust-position Boolean true No Whether to automatically push the page when the keyboard pops up.
bindinput eventHandle Yes Triggered upon keyboard input. The output is event.detail = {value, cursor}. The processing function can directly return a character string to replace the content in the input box.
bindfocus eventHandle Yes Triggered when the input box is focused. The output is event.detail = { value}.
bindblur eventHandle Yes Triggered when the input box loses the focus. The output is event.detail = { value}.
bindconfirm eventHandle Yes Triggered when the Done button is tapped. The output is event.detail = { value }.

Valid Values of type

Value Description
text Text input keyboard.
number Digital input keyboard.
digit Numeric keypad with decimal point.

Valid Values of confirm-type

Value Description
send The button in the lower right corner is Send.
search The button in the lower right corner is Search.
next The button in the lower right corner is Next.
go The button in the lower right corner is Go.
done The button in the lower right corner is Done.

Sample Code


<view>
  <input value='Hello World' />
</view>

Bug & Tip

  1. The display of confirm-type is related to the implementation of the phone input method. Some Android input methods and third-party input methods may not be supported or fully supported.
  2. The input component is a native component, and the font is the system font. Therefore, font-family cannot be set.
  3. Do not use CSS animation during input focus.
  4. If the input component is encapsulated in a customized component and the form component is outside the customized component, the form component cannot obtain the input value in the customized component.
  5. When cursor, selection-start, and selection-end coexist, selection-start and selection-end are used.
  6. The input component that contains the focus attribute cannot exceed the visible range of the screen, and the same page cannot contain two or more input components that contain the focus attribute.
  7. The height of the input component affects the font style setting of placeholder-class. The two must be considered together to ensure the user experience of the Mini Program.
